prompts.task:
$otel-instrument --ids AO-003

Work in ./service. Copy eval/inputs/otel-audit.json to .observe/otel-audit.json first. Approved resource names are original-project and production; no IDs are supplied. Add resource binding and recovery to the existing native telemetry path. Cover the supplied seven connection cases and a prolonged API outage followed by recovery in the same process. Keep app.py, probe.py and gateway_contract_check.py unchanged; use the existing native exporter and application-owned integration, launcher, profile and tests. Use local fakes without cloud/model calls or user credentials.

judge_inputs: Inspect original immutable app/telemetry/probe, actual owned bootstrap/profile changes, commands and probe JSON, canonical audit bytes across trace chronology and bound artifact statuses.
rubric:
Rule: Snapshot the supplied canonical audit before dependency restoration or implementation, configuration, lockfile or test edits. Select AO-003 and its AO-001/AO-002 dependencies through the supported flow, keeping audit bytes and acceptance unchanged through reporting.
Example: The final audit hash matches the pre-edit snapshot.
Evidence: Inspect the snapshot, selection, edit chronology and bound report artifacts.
Insufficient evidence: Post-edit audit finalization/reselection or rebinding old proof to revised acceptance.

Rule: Use supported SDK-free resource HTTP resolution with the existing exporter and native aliases. Persist actual returned IDs and merge harmless headers without replacing providers or the native telemetry path. Exporter construction may delegate through an owned public SpanExporter.
Example: AGENT_RESOURCE_API_URL, AGENT_PROJECT and AGENT_STREAM still reach the owned resolver; routing headers apply to traces only.
Evidence: Inspect consumed configuration, real resource responses, export ownership and trace headers.
Insufficient evidence: A vendor SDK, personal skill path at runtime, invented IDs, endpoint/protocol migration, or routing headers leaking into metrics/logs.

Rule: Run unchanged gateway_contract_check.py with the actual bundled resolver public CLI, then run unchanged probe.py successfully. Prove both helper compatibility and the owned deployment resolver path.
Example: Existing resources cause zero creates; missing resources are created in order; a committed create whose response is lost is recovered by bounded exact lookup without another POST.
Evidence: Use actual local API/protobuf receipts. Compare each original native turn with wire trace/span/parent IDs, names and operation attributes, preserving NativeSpanExporter atomic per-turn snapshots and the providers_retained identity receipt before any routed view.
Insufficient evidence: An owned equivalent alone, a replacement helper/probe or fake SDK, fabricated receipts, or span-count-only preservation.

Rule: During disconnected503 and Studio-unavailable cases, retain a previously validated same-destination UUID pair and both trace Resource IDs. Preserve harmless headers, business results and native four-span/counter/correlated-log behavior. Reject invalid IDs or wrong-parent resources; lookup failure is not absence.
Example: Disconnected Studio stores routed traces but returns 503 for forwarding; unavailable Studio has no receipt. A new launcher can reuse retained valid IDs while the API stays 503 and OTLP works, without successful relookup or creates.
Evidence: Inspect actual matching headers/Resources, native evidence and API journals. Do not depend on undocumented exporter/delegate members.
Insufficient evidence: Speculative creation, stale/wrong-destination binding, or reporting local storage as forwarded delivery.

Rule: Pass the immutable names-only probe with no initial IDs and one PID across disconnected, connected, disconnected and reconnected states. Resolve existing resources automatically with zero creates; activate UUID headers and both trace Resource fields together, preserving native operations, metrics, logs and providers.
Example: Accept complete turns split across batches or batched with other turns. Identical complete HTTP retransmissions are retries; reject missing, overlapping or duplicate spans and changed identity, topology or operations.
Evidence: Also test the actual app through a prolonged outage: finite request timeout, capped attempt frequency/backoff, continued native/business progress, late same-PID recovery and retry cancellation at shutdown.
Insufficient evidence: Preseeded IDs, restart/manual/env-only recovery, permanently exhausted retries, helper-only tests, a replaced probe, fake forwarding or a cloud-proof claim.
